data.author: Jeffrey Lutz
data.notes: Contemporaneous pre-arrest report explicitly attributes the May 4 robbery facts to Garden City police and places Joyeria America at 308 E. Fulton Street. This creates a location-text discrepancy with later reporting/issue prose that has rendered the address as 308 W. Fulton. This source did not identify Alberto Rincon at the time.
